snippet.title: The Angel's Mandate - Chapter One [ANNOUNCEMENT TEASER]
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4338480/The_Angels_Mandate/

The Angel's Mandate is a first-person horror game where you play as Jesse, who finds himself in the palace of an angel after his mother falls ill, slowly losing her senses and physical control, one piece at a time. The angel claims you can save her, and asks you to face a trial beyond mortal limits.

You are sent through rifts into corrupted realms, each ruled by a fiend. Within these worlds lie shattered monuments, remnants of an ancient power. To save your mother, you must explore these hostile spaces, evade their inhabitants, recover the fragments, and reassemble what was broken.

Each descent tests your resolve, your courage, and how much you are willing to endure for someone you love.
